name: Grand Prix de Denain - Porte du Hainaut
story: A slow-forming breakaway never gained a significant advantage, with the peloton regrouping at 58 km to go and triggering a series of attacks. Alec Segaert and Per Strand Hagenes went clear at 45 km. After a cat-and-mouse game that started on the final cobbles sector, Segaert surged past Hagenes inside the final kilometres to take victory just ahead of the peloton.
